notes.title: Leaderboard Update Announcement
notes.notes:
🎲 Leaderboard Update in CATAN Universe

Hey Catanians!
next monday on August 4th we’re rolling out a major Elo adjustment, based on your feedback, to make ranked play across all expansions fairer, more competitive, and more accurate.


🧮 Elo Values Are Being Adjusted 
We are not clearing the leaderboards; instead, we’re applying targeted Elo corrections to improve fairness and competition without disrupting the game too much.

What’s happening to Elo ratings:

Elo above 1400 → adjusted to 1400


Elo between 800–1400 → unchanged


Elo below 800 → raised up to 800



✅ This one-time correction happens automatically on your login once the backed fix has been deployed on August 4th. Your updated Elo will be reflected on the leaderboard.


 👉 Please be aware that in the first hours of this adjustment, your Prestige rank might fluctuate a bit. Once the majority of active players log in again, your  Prestige rank will be displayed correctly according to the new leaderboard distribution. 

Why are we doing this:

 This creates a more balanced competitive environment, allowing both returning and active players to play on more equal footing. Everyone gets a fresh chance, without a full reset. And matchmaking will get faster again. 



🧍‍♂️ Inactive High-Elo Accounts Will Be Temporarily Removed (August 6th to August 8th) 
To clean up the top of the leaderboard and make space for active players, we’ll be manually removing leaderboard entries for accounts with Elo above 1400 that haven’t logged on the servers in the days after the change was deployed. 


 ⏳ These entries aren’t gone forever.
 👉 As soon as they log in, they will receive the same Elo adjustment and reappear on the leaderboard with their corrected rating.

Elo above 1400 → adjusted to 1400

Why are we doing this:
We want to give everyone the chance to get settled in on the new leaderboards, and we also want to make sure, after a grace period, that we get everyone who is actively playing at the top of the leaderboards in the spot they deserve based on their Elo.



🏆 Elo Cap Introduced: Max 1800
To keep the competitive experience balanced and exciting, we’re capping Elo values at 1800 going forward. 

Why this is beneficial:
It prevents runaway scores and ensures that matchmaking, even at the very top, will be faster. 



🧭 Better Matchmaking 
Thanks to a better Elo distribution and leaderboard maintenance, matchmaking will be faster and more accurate again for everyone. You'll be paired with players closer to your skill level.



📣 This Update Was Built on Your Feedback
Your voices made this happen. We’ve been listening to your suggestions and concerns, including:

“Please remove inactive players from the top.”



“Matchmaking feels uneven.”



“Elo doesn’t reflect current skill anymore.”



This update will be our response — and we’ll continue monitoring its impact closely. More improvements will follow, always guided by the community.


The CATAN Universe Team

notes.title: Developer Update XX
notes.notes:
Hello Catanians, 🏝️


Our team has been working hard to make further significant improvements to the game and servers: We analyzed and fixed inefficiencies in the way you connect to the servers when logging in with your account. These caused issues during rush hours when many Catanians joined the game. This had a cascading effect, as poor performance led to users logging out and logging in again, making the issues worse. 📉

We understand that many of the issues you report that are very hard to reproduce and only happen intermediately are related to "calls" (requests for information between the game, server, and other players) that are not processed in time. 
To alleviate this problem, we have furthermore significantly decreased the workload on our servers from calls not directly related to the (multiplayer)-game. This redesign of the login process and account system will hopefully result in a significant boost in overall performance and reliability, without any major changes for you. 📈

We are now in the final stages of testing the new client and server update and plan to release it next week 📅. Once again, thank you for your patience and understanding during this process. Exact dates for server maintenance and update releases will be announced as soon as possible.

notes.title: Developer Update XIX
notes.notes:
Hello Catanians, 📢


This week's developer update will focus on the learning we had from our latest client update. As many of you know, update 2.3.3 was released on May 24th. It was a significant step forward in making sure we can identify underlying online performance issues more easily.✅


As expected,  we did encounter some inefficiencies that caused the servers to struggle during peak hours, resulting in issues with payments, matchmaking, Elo display, disconnects, and so on. 🤬


🎉Fortunately, we were able to roll out an update to our servers beginning of last week that addressed the majority of these inefficiencies. Based on our statistics and your feedback, we've seen an overall improvement in performance and reliability. 🎉


🧑‍💻Our team is committed to continuing to work on improving the game's infrastructure by replacing inefficient code with more modern solutions. We understand that these inefficiencies can sometimes only become apparent when we have a large number of concurrent users or when we're integrating new features. That can make it harder to pinpoint the actual root cause of an issue at times. 🧑‍💻


Our team is hard at work on the next version of the game, which will include improvements to reduce the amount of data sent to clients upon login which will further decrease the workload on the servers. 📶


We plan to release this update in the coming weeks. After its release, we will assess its performance before moving on to bringing back some beloved features. 📆




Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work to make the game better for all Catanians.

So, if you have an older version, just make sure to update it before you play to avoid any problems in the future.


Our team is currently focused on reducing the amount of time it takes to find a match, and we will keep you updated on our progress. As a result of the migration, our block lists have drastically expanded, leading to slower matchmaking times. Some Catanians have block lists with over 240 entries. Hi Catanians, 

In this week's developer update, we want to focus on how you can reach out to us to get assistance. And shed some light on the issues we are currently facing which are hindering this week's release of a client update. 

Last Week Jan 23rd - Jan 29th 

Our dev team is closing in on the underlying issue of the host switching system, which causes many of the issues in multiplayer you experience once one player leaves a match.  In short, the host of a game is making sure the game is progressing in order.  If there is an issue with the host switch, you can see games getting stalled or the A.I. not responding. This also can affect the display of trades or the ability to trade in the game. 

To resolve these issues, the host switch is getting rewritten to work properly with the new backend in several edge-case scenarios. This also affects the clients' behavior when it comes to reconnecting to games in general, an issue that we’ve been working on optimizing in the last weeks. Both topics are interconnected and depend heavily on each other. 

This Week Jan 30th - Feb 5th

Right now it is our plan to create a combination of improvements we mentioned above to have a more substantial impact on your experience with online games. Unfortunately, this means that we will need more time before we can release since as described above there are a lot of dependencies and even more test cases to go through. As we tested, we still found issues, e.g. when the turn timer runs out while a player is reconnecting to a game, and we will address these first before the release. 

We increased our efforts to get in touch with our Catanians directly on Discord to help out with individual issues. We want to encourage everyone to reach out to us there and we will do our best to resolve issues and collect feedback via this channel. We want to thank any Catanian who already made use of our Discord Server to get in touch with us since your feedback already is helping us immensely.

Hi Catanians, 

our team pushed hard for a release today but unfortunately, we have to delay the release of the client until tomorrow Nov 4th. 

We want to give you some info about what was happening in the past few days and where we are right now: 

On Monday night the servers of our old provider went offline and they started to back up the user database. 

We received a compressed form of this backup on Tuesday which we had to download and unpack. This step alone (creating the backup, downloading, and unpacking it)  took more than 24 hours due to the millions of accounts we have in Catan Universe. We knew before this will take as long as it did because we tested it already a few times.

On Wednesday we started prepping the database we received to allow for the migration to our new server and backend provider. This is an automated process that unfortunately is taking way longer than we anticipated and tested. 

The preparation of the database for the migration is a crucial step to make sure the actual migration of your accounts works as intended. 

Since we are running out of time today to orderly release one platform after the other, we made the decision to postpone those releases until tomorrow. This will allow us to monitor the migration throughout the day. Please keep in mind that we are working in the CET timezone so for you this might be during the night or in the early morning. But as we stated before, all you need to do is download the new client once it's available. Everything else will be explained in the game. 

We are truly sorry about the delays but we do not see any point in rushing into a release of the game clients if the database is not ready yet and especially if at some point our team wouldn´t be available to monitor the process due to it getting too late in the day.

notes.title: Catan Universe start phase and info on upcomming patch
notes.notes:
Dear Catanians,

we are currently working full speed on alleviating the problems occurring during the start phase of games in CATAN Universe and we are already testing a version that plays promisingly.

Unfortunately, problems of the kind we're currently having, are very tedious to test since they sometimes do simply not occur during our testing phase.

Today we wanted to provide you with a little context on why this is happening:

Usually, we don't test the beta client on the same server that you folks are playing but instead on an identical version of that server. This has 2 reasons:

To properly test the newest version we have to start 100s of games that we have no intention of ever finishing. Sometimes we just start and close games immediately afterward to see how the game behaves during this phase. Were we to do that on the live servers, it' be no way of ensuring that we'd not be matched with any of you folks.

Most of the time a new client version (1.8.8 -> 1.8.9) needs an updated server software as well and that new software is rarely fully backward compatible. And since running two different instances of server software on the same server creates a myriad of problems in and of itself we opt to test on our test server.

So since we did not have the start phase issues in CATAN Universe 1.8.8 on our testing servers, we first had to create a 1.8.9 version that would work on the current live servers without interfering with your folks playing. We were able to test the first iteration of CATAN Universe 1.8.9 yesterday and we're continuing to test today and tomorrow.

We'll, of course, keep you up to date on how our work is progressing.

Thanks a lot for all of your patience and feedback and we'll see you on the island!

notes.title: “Arrival on Catan”: More free content for every Catan Universe user with update 1.4.0!
notes.notes:
The brand new free to play introduction “Arrival on Catan” familiarizes every new and old Catanian to all the different aspects and features of Catan Universe.

Once you have completed the tasks for the “Arrival on Catan” you  will permanently unlock the Single-Player and Custom-Match modes for the basic “Arrival on Catan” scenario.

 This means: More free content for every Catan Universe user! You don´t even need an account to get started! 


Our old friend Candamir will assist you in your first steps on the island. You will play games in every expansion available in Catan Universe and get challenged by the AI. 

If you already registered an account before update 1.4, you will be rewarded with the unlocks of "Arrival on Catan" automatically. This means custom games with friends as well as games against AI players in the “Arrival on Catan” scenario are now available for free to every registered player! 

If you want to play the introduction anyway, you can  restart the "Arrival of Catan" via the options menu. You will face the same challenges as a new player, but might also get to play expansions you don´t have unlocked yet. 

Have fun with “Arrival on Catan”!
